rs_how: Put your finger on the tortoise, and slide it this way.
rs_back_1: That way is backwards. We always read from left to right.
rs_back_2: Let's try again from the tortoise. Ninjas always start on this side.
rs_back_3: The tortoise only walks this way. Start here, and slide it along.
rs_start_here: Let's start on this side. Put your finger on the tortoise.
rs_idle: Put your finger on the tortoise when you're ready.
rs_keep_going: Keep going, all the way to the rabbit.
rs_again: Let's slide it again, from the very start.
rs_sounds_with_me: Now you slide it, and say the sounds with me.
rs_now_fast: That was the slow way. Now tap the rabbit, and say it fast.
rs_slowly: The tortoise likes to go slowly. Try it slowly, like me.
rs_praise_1: You read each little word, then the whole big word.
rs_praise_2: Tortoise first, then the rabbit. That's ninja reading!
rs_praise_3: You started at the beginning, and went all the way.
pr_demo: Two little words can make one long word. I'll read this one slowly first. Watch my paw...
pr_demo_back: Now watch what happens if I start on the other side...
